mapper.select:
select AGENCY_ID id, AGENCY_NAME text from DIS_SALE_AGENCY
and (AGENCY_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or AGENCY_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
select count(1) count from V_REP_PROD_INFO where STATUS='E' and PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select dpa.AGENCY_ID agencyId, info.PROD_SERIES prodSeries, dpa.PROD_ID prodId from DIS_PROD_AGENCY dpa left join V_REP_PROD_INFO info on dpa.PROD_ID=info.PROD_ID where dpa.AGENCY_ID=#{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select dpa.AGENCY_ID agencyId, dsa.AGENCY_NAME agencyName from DIS_PROD_AGENCY dpa left join DIS_SALE_AGENCY dsa on dpa.AGENCY_ID=dsa.SEQUENCE_NO where dpa.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
